why: Agent B's CRITICAL C1. The V1 mapping was HAND-WRITTEN and its stored reason -- 'No :Devata in this registry carries this phenomenon's Sanskrit stem' -- was FALSE on two public nodes: VG:CONCEPT:USAS-DAWN (stem usas) against VG:DEVATA:USAH (label_iast usas, is_deity true) and VG:CONCEPT:CANDRAMAS-MOON (stem candramas) against VG:DEVATA:CANDRAMAH (label_iast candramas). Both are exact primary-stem matches on the same field that matched AGNI-FIRE. The same R4 migration landed a COMPOSED_OF edge to VG:DEVATA:USAH, so one arm used the deity while another denied it existed. V2 DERIVES the mapping from the same surface index that produced the accepted rows instead of hand-writing it, and records the match tier.
